description: USE WHEN you do not yet know what this server can do (call hello first for orientation). By default returns a compact summary: every MCP tool with a one-line purpose, the workflow titles, the reporting rules and the contract links. Pass detail=true for the complete inventory (endpoint paths, when to use each tool, full multi-step workflows, coordination vocabularies); that payload is large, so request it only when the summary is not enough.

detail.description: true returns the complete (large) capability inventory. Default false returns a compact summary.

name: list_capabilities
